summary.text: John Mahoney is a Democratic state representative from the 13th Worcester District who has held the seat since 2011 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: John Mahoney is a small business owner and attended Bryant College.
He assumed office in 2011, and in the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee and serves on the Human Resources and Employee Engagement Committee.
